items.author: FindleysFinance
items.text:
$META
 Muse launched in Japan, its first country outside North America.

US: Sep 8. Canada: Sep 18. Japan: Oct 23.

10M+ downloads in 6 weeks, 25% daily use. Constraint is compute, not demand.

Japan is no soft launch. It's the most contested AI market: ChatGPT holds just 57% there vs 80% in the US, and it's Gemini's #2 market globally.

OpenAI and Anthropic both opened their first Asia offices in Tokyo. Early success in Japan could be a VERY GOOD SIGN for Muse.
